name: caffeine-tracker
description: Browser-only caffeine tracker with work-hours reminders.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run build && npm run audit
